authoredBefore: any execution of the six reference-check commands in this review
basis: Independently derived from (a) my own pin verification in probe-02 (1099/71/73/65 = 1308 entries all valid) and (b) the frozen final-reference.v16 logs, which I treat as the claim under test, not as an oracle.

expectations.name: foundation
expectations.independentGrounding: sourceFileCount must equal the 1099 foundation pins I independently verified in probe-02; sourcePinsValid must be true because I verified every one of those 1099 digests against the frozen bytes myself.

expectations.name: security
expectations.independentGrounding: 456 passing calls is a count of passing security-sweep calls, not a product security qualification.

expectations.name: native
expectations.expectedStdout: PASS: 347/347 cases; matrix cells 66; open objects 0; uncovered feedback []
expectations.independentGrounding: 347 native cases with actual scope; 66 matrix cells is the 11-capability x 6-mode grid. Not product qualification. This checker writes its report in-tree, so it is only run in copy-A.

expectations.name: workflows
expectations.independentGrounding: sourceFileCount must equal the 65 workflows pins I independently verified in probe-02.

expectations.name: integration
expectations.independentGrounding: 365 passing integration assertions over synthetic TCB inputs; syntheticTcbInputs true is itself the disclosure that no real TCB was exercised.

determinismExpectation: Two consecutive runs in two independent disposable copies must produce byte-identical stdout and byte-identical in-tree report files, otherwise the reports are not deterministic and the frozen results cannot be bound.
repinPolicy: No pin will be rewritten under any circumstance. A pin failure is a review finding, not something to repair.
